title: Spacewar 7800
tagline: Bill Seiler's 1985 Spacewar, on the Atari 7800 and the AstroCart
ready: Press Z to play. Click or press a key for sound.
about: A port of Bill Seiler's 1985 DOS Spacewar: two ships duel around a sun, with real 1/r² gravity, against the computer or a friend on the second set of keys.
The Needle carries photon torpedoes and a cloak, the Wedge phasers and hyperspace. Gravity can be normal, reversed or off, and the edges wrap or bounce.
The gravity and the ships' turning run on the AstroCart's math unit: its CORDIC block rotates the vectors and its divider computes the pull of the sun.
